subject: science
passage: Venus spins more slowly than any other planet in the solar system. One full rotation takes about 243 Earth days, while one trip around the Sun takes only about 225 Earth ______ Venus, a single spin lasts longer than a whole year.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "One full rotation takes about 243 Earth days, while one trip around the Sun takes only about 225 Earth days" is a complete sentence, and "on Venus, a single spin lasts longer than a whole year" is another. Two independent clauses need a strong boundary such as a period.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A comma alone can't join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
explanation.B: Incorrect. When "and" joins two independent clauses, a comma is needed before it.
explanation.C: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the clauses run together, and "225 Earth days on Venus" is misread as one phrase.
explanation.D: Correct. A period ends the first independent clause, and the second begins as a new sentence.
